project.ItemDescriptionShort: Shows what a quest's Town Event reward actually does, right on the quest select screen.
project.Title: Expeditions Town Events Hints
project.ItemDescription:
Gather and Activate quests reward you with a Town Event, but the quest screen only ever tells you its name. "Silence in the Crypts" does not tell you anything, so you end up on the wiki.
This mod prints what the event actually does, right underneath the name.
[b]Before[/b] Town Event: Silence in the Crypts
[b]After[/b] Town Event: Silence in the Crypts Ruins: +33% Resolve XP, +15% DMG
[b]Covers all 8 quest-reward events[/b] Activate quests: Silence in the Crypts, Sunshine in the Thicket, Gentle Tide, Fresh Air in the Tunnels. Gather quests: All Saints Day, Caregivers Convention, Lost and Found, Bumper Crop.
[b]What it changes[/b] Text only. It is a localization override of the eight event title strings - no gameplay, no balance, no stats, and no layout files. Every number is read straight out of the game's own buff definitions rather than copied from a guide.
The lines are written short on purpose so they fit the quest panel without anything being clipped or moved.
Because the title strings are shared, the effect lines also appear in the town event announcement and in the activity log entry for these eight events.
[b]English only[/b] Playing in another language? Use "Expeditions Town Events Hints (International)" instead. Do not run both.
Other languages are unaffected by this version - they simply fall back to the vanilla event names.
[b]Compatibility[/b] Conflicts only with mods that rewrite these same eight strings. Safe to add or remove mid-campaign.
